notes.title: Join For Free | PLAYTEST #1
notes.content: [h2][b]We’ve just kicked off CST’s very first playtest, and you can now apply through our Steam page![/b]🔥[/h2][p][/p][p]At the end of the playtest, you’ll see a feedback form it would mean a lot to us if you filled it out. We're building this project with the community, and your feedback, ideas, and bug reports are incredibly valuable.[/p][p]We've also updated the game's Steam visuals and will be releasing a gameplay trailer soon. Please don't hesitate to share your feedback on the new store images![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478752/527fad49577fd5428c85a74f7e92af8f3e259cf6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Playtest #1 Contents ![/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]General CO-OP Testing[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Customer System[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Customer Request Variety[/p][/*][*][p]Customer Mesh Variant[/p][/*][/olist][/*][*][p][b]Building System[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Inside Building (Machines)[/p][/*][*][p]Outdoor Slots (Customer Delivery & Accept Park Slot)[/p][/*][/olist][/*][*][p][b]Machine Testing[/b][/p][olist][*][p] Car Lift[/p][/*][*][p] Tire Changer[/p][/*][*][p] Tire Balancer[/p][/*][*][p] Battery Charger[/p][/*][/olist][/*][*][p][b]Repair Systems[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Mechanical Part Replacement[/p][/*][*][p]Battery Charge[/p][/*][*][p]Tire Change and Balance[/p][/*][/olist][/*][*][p][b]Shoping Car Parts[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Day/Night Cycle[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Beta Map[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Basic Economy[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Reputation System[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]You'll be able to learn about the new systems coming in [b]Test #2[/b] through a detailed window that will appear during [b]Test #1[/b]. This way, you'll have a clearer view of the game's progression and future updates.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]CO-OP Mode ?[/b][/h3][p]The game supports both singleplayer and co-op modes, so you can play however you like. Players who gain access can directly grant access to 3 Steam friends during the test. Those without friends and those who want to play co-op can meet other mechanics in the [b]Official CST Discord server[/b] under the [b]#hire-mechanics[/b] channel and add Steam friends to share access.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478752/13af82bdab54558ac98e11ba672f0dbd62ddfd4f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]When Downloadable ?[/b][/h3][p]The first wave of approvals is expected [b]Next Week[/b]. Have fun, and we’re looking forward to seeing your thoughts![/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Playtest Access ?[/b][/h3][p]This won’t be a single playtest we’re planning multiple testing phases. Those who can’t join the first one will have the chance to access the next playtests as we increase the number of available player slots.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]What are the latest developments in the project ?[/b][/h3][p]We haven’t shared a devlog about CST in a while. During the last Steam Next Fest, we mentioned that we would release a demo of the game. However, we’ve decided to adjust that plan in order to deliver a more stable, polished, and enjoyable experience.[/p][p]Instead of a demo, we’re moving forward with a playtest approach that allows us to gather early and direct feedback from players. This way, we’ll have the opportunity to shape the game together.[/p][p]We’ve made significant progress during this time, and below I’m sharing some key updates with you;[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Performance Survey ![/b][/h3][p]To get the most out of the playtest, we’ll be collecting some statistical data from players. This includes:[/p][list][*][p]Your GPU model and average FPS[/p][/*][*][p]Whether or not you completed the tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]Time spent on each customer request[/p][/*][*][p]Total RP and money earned[/p][p]and more...[/p][/*][/list][p]These insights will help us improve gameplay dynamics and guide the optimization process.[/p][p]We’ve also prepared a feedback form for players to share comments, suggestions, or any bugs they encounter at the end of the playtest.[/p][p]We’ll be reviewing this data closely.[/p][p]Our programmers are currently working on adapting the existing car physics system to support co-op gameplay, ensuring a smooth and synchronized driving experience across all players.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Modular Engine ![/b][/h3][p]On the 3d design side, the biggest progress has been made on the car engine system.[/p][p]We've been working on a modular engine setup for quite a while, and we’re excited to share that it's now complete. Excluding bolts, [b]the engine currently consists of over 70+ individual parts[/b], including multiple types of:[/p][list][*][p]Belts[/p][/*][*][p]Sparks[/p][/*][*][p]Camshaft pulleys[/p][/*][*][p]Cylinder head covers[/p][/*][*][p]Oil filters[/p][/*][*][p]Pistons[/p][p]and more...[/p][/*][/list][p]In addition to the engine itself, we’ve also completed many of the components under the hood, such as the radiator, oil/antifreeze/water tanks, ECU, ABS pump, fuse box, and more. I’ll be sharing visuals of these parts with you![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478752/c3f0c98b0277acef80ab03940afeb87bb02e2b2a.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478752/0f3cfec231eea141323ab0151352657f5d0a2637.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: CST - DEVLOG #3
notes.content:
[url=https://discord.com/invite/X5Mzfjtbst][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478752/176e8ce076b0153c63d6da3e5cafbc16fabe0b1e.png[/img][/url]

[b]In Car Service Together's (CST) DevLog series, we aim to share the game's roadmap, newly added systems, and the innovations we are working on. To stay updated on developments, please join our Discord channel![/b]

[h1]Hello again, CST followers![/h1]

[h3]We've been receiving a lot of messages from you about [b]DevLog #3[/b], and we've been working hard to prepare a detailed and exciting update in response. CST has now reached [b]40,000+[/b]  wishlists, and we're getting very close to launching the demo![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3501070[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478752/59149cdd3233be3ce12baf649a8511c8c817be86.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[h3]The first DevLog topic is: [b]Mod Support[/b][/h3]

[b]We're happy to share that CST now has full modding infrastructure in place![/b]

CST is being developed by a small team of just three dev, with all 3D art handled by a single team member. Since we’ve made a conscious decision to avoid using premade assets, community support is incredibly valuable to us. That’s why mod support has been one of our top priorities from the start.

If you have experience with modding, you’ll be able to reach out to us via our [b]Discord[/b] server after the demo is released to help test and improve the system ahead of time!

[url=https://carservicetogether.gitbook.io/cst-mod-guide]You can check out the CST Mod Guide here![/url]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Second DevLog topic is: [b]Tools[/b][/h3]

If you’ve been following our development on Discord, you already know we’ve been working on several machines for quite some time. We're happy to announce that they are now fully integrated into the project and fully co-op compatible!

[list]
[*] [b]Lift :[/b] Allows you to raise vehicles to three different heights, making it easy to move and work around them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478752/2bb5ac6c78f635e7aff391ad1f2eb0831f6f9983.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Lowest Level: [/b] Access to engine bay and bodywork
[*] [b]Mid Level: [/b] Ideal for working on wheels and suspension
[*] [b]Top Level: [/b] Lets you remove the engine, perform oil changes, exhaust maintenance, and more
[/list]
[*] [b]Tire Changer :[/b] Handles mounting and unmounting of tires and rims.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478752/8472fd2390f6f39c8dc1585b79d505646b5ca82c.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Tire Balancer :[/b] Balances the mounted tires and rims to make them usable. This process merges the two parts into a single usable product.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478752/8178129df978a15fbfab50345919be00a8e228e9.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Battery Charger :[/b] Recharges and increases the durability of batteries. However, batteries that fall below a certain condition threshold will no longer be rechargeable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478752/49c7e2753f4dc3c089d3f3497bfdcbd6d0b72ab9.gif[/img]

[/list]
And yes — more machines are on the way!
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Third DevLog topic is: [b]Different Characters[/b][/h3]

We’re planning to introduce a character customization system during the Early Access phase, and our infrastructure is already built to support it. However, for the demo, there will be [b]4 different characters available[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478752/1096799b153071401c1170307231c16803446a20.png[/img]

In the future, we’ll be adding new;
[list]
[*] Overalls
[*] Outfits
[*] Hats
[*] Shoes
[/list]
to the game!
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Fourth DevLog topic is: [b]User Interface (UI)[/b][/h3]

All UI screens designed for CST are now complete, and most of them have already been integrated into the game. Their usability and functionality will continue to evolve through testing and player feedback.
And a little surprise: CST will [b]offer FULL GAMEPAD support![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478752/b23f5c57d8c3fc791c0bcc0a096d6a6739ce645e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478752/b0d1a4852bc4baa21d3c941ed91910c4e9be7fc7.gif[/img]
[i]Most of the content shown in the photos and GIFs throughout this DevLog is still under development and does not represent the final version. Some logos and brand visuals may be placeholders or subject to copyright, and will be replaced in the final release![/i]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Fifth DevLog topic is: [b]Parts and Upgrades[/b][/h3]

We've been focusing heavily on customizable and upgradeable car parts. At this point, how these parts function and appear is mostly finalized. Each item now has a [b]Rarity Level[/b], and we've introduced a [b]Service Quality[/b] score. This allows you to easily compare a low-rarity but highly durable part with a high-rarity part that may have lower durability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478752/12c8aa6ab6ea151ab0f3885ee58a0caceb8d1216.gif[/img]

Additionally, these parts will directly affect key vehicle stats such as:
[list]
[*] Weight
[*] Handling
[*] Braking
[*] 0 - 100 km/h - 0-60 mph
[*] Top Speed
[*] Horsepower
[*] 0 - 400 m - 1/4 mile
[*] Torque
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Sixth DevLog topic is: [b]Feeling[/b][/h3]

After sharing our suspension system video, we took the feedback and test results to further improve the in-game feel.
[list]
[*]Updated outline and ghost colors for better clarity
[*]Added new sound effects to enhance immersion
[*]Refined the control system to make it more intuitive
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]What’s Coming Next?[/h3]

As promised, CST will be featured with a playable demo in the upcoming Steam Next Fest! Our demo page is launching very soon, and we’ll be sharing all the details again once it’s live.

Don’t forget to [b]Follow Us On Steam[/b] and [b]Join Our Discord[/b] to stay up to date with the latest developments and [b]Add CST To Your Wishlist[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478752/1eaaf480db20a196db59380fcf9fcf51e548177e.gif[/img]
[spoiler] AND, ARE YOU READY! [/spoiler]

notes.title: CST - DEVLOG #2
notes.content:
[url=https://discord.com/invite/X5Mzfjtbst][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478752/176e8ce076b0153c63d6da3e5cafbc16fabe0b1e.png[/img][/url]

[b]In Car Service Together's (CST) DevLog series, we aim to share the game's roadmap, newly added systems, and the innovations we are working on. To stay updated on developments, please join our Discord channel![/b]

[h1]Hello CST Followers![/h1]

[h3]We know you've been eagerly waiting for Devlog #2! Since Devlog #1, our team has made significant progress, and thanks to your incredible support, we've reached [b]30,000+[/b]  wishlists! We truly appreciate each and every one of you![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3501070[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478752/59149cdd3233be3ce12baf649a8511c8c817be86.gif[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]The first DevLog topic is: [b]RADA[/b][/h3]

[b]We promised, and now it's here. The detailed modeling of RADA is complete!  [/b]

Alongside all mechanical and bodywork details, you'll have access to a wide range of customization options, including:  
[list]
[*]Steering wheels  
[*]Seats  
[*]Gear knobs  
[*]Decorative air fresheners  
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478752/3147942bb5238a2b28dfb1313a14e89be24c8865.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478752/b5f2b2cd626ce6c4c5533fbfd3e9d499752f08f7.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Second DevLog topic is: [b]Suspension System[/b][/h3]

[b]One of the most important aspects of our vehicles, along with the main frame and chassis, is the suspension system. [/b]

In the suspension section, you’ll be able to customize:  
[list]
[*]Springs  
[*]Brake discs & calipers  
[*]Rims & tires 
[/list] 
But that’s not all... we’re also bringing you a surprise street tuning style like you’ve never seen before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478752/b41ad22f7fd7c8fbec8754d5e9696aae6958df8e.gif[/img]  
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Last DevLog topic is: [b]Customize Characters & Outfits[/b][/h3]

[b]Our main characters have finally stepped onto the stage. [/b]

For now, they come with work overalls and color options, but stay tuned—soon, you'll be able to:  
[list]
[*]Choose between male & female characters  
[*]Customize outfits and work uniforms  
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478752/add9f3f79f1ecd47759ce52bb31bade55989e6bb.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h1]Community is everything![/h1]

[b]We can’t wait to hear your thoughts on these updates. What are you most excited about? Let us know in our Discord and be part of the journey.  [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478752/90846d9d57c99f35fc75b20dd7038142681f93a5.gif[/img]

notes.title: CST - DEVLOG #1
notes.content:
[url=https://discord.com/invite/X5Mzfjtbst][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478752/176e8ce076b0153c63d6da3e5cafbc16fabe0b1e.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Hello CST Followers![/h1]

[h3]First of all, we want to thank everyone who supported us and helped us reach over [b]20,000+[/b] wishlists in just 3 days! This incredible interest motivates us to move forward with even more enthusiasm and confidence as we develop the project.[/h3]
[b]
In Car Service Together's (CST) DevLog series, we aim to share the game's roadmap, newly added systems, and the innovations we are working on. To stay updated on developments, please join our Discord channel![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3501070[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478752/59149cdd3233be3ce12baf649a8511c8c817be86.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h3]The first DevLog topic is: [b]Bodywork Repairs 🔧[/b][/h3]

The custom shader technologies we developed for the CST project realistically reflect rust and paint damage on car bodies. Moreover, each vehicle features unique damage scenarios, making every repair process a different experience!

When customers visit your shop, they may request bodywork and paint jobs. Here’s what you need to do in such cases:

[list]
[*]Generate an inspection report to identify the damage, as customers' requests might be vague and unclear.
[*]Once you determine the parts that need fixing, use a grinder to remove paint and rust from the affected area.
[*]Head to the paint machine in your shop, select a color, and mix the paint.
[*]Manually apply the paint using a brush. Of course, painting over rust might seem like a quick fix, but be careful—your customers will notice it right away! 😉
[/list]
[b]A true mechanic never overlooks the details![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478752/95ca30caa93131529f15045991d8aae67ffa0307.gif[/img]
[i]Most of the content in the photos and GIFs you'll see throughout the DevLog is still in the development stage and is not the final version![/i]

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Community is everything![/h1]

[b]In response to the support we’ve received from you, we've decided to add one of the most requested vehicles to the game, and it will be featured in the vehicle demo version. You can think of this as a small thank you from us![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478752/25da2fab0d94fa510b6cd46a99a58e4daaa177b7.gif[/img]
[spoiler] Keep following and join us on Discord :)[/spoiler]
